# Room reactions, edits, deletes and files (#4796, #4797, #4812)

Retention: retained as bounded before/after review evidence for #4796, #4797 and #4812. Replace only with superseding reviewed evidence.

Images live on the orphan branch `pr-assets/room-message-actions-4796`, pinned at commit `eb792c1db156`; `receipt.json` lists each file's SHA-256.

After: this branch at `820aa0e96626`, from a full local gallery run (186 screens). Before: the branch base `ed7173470f33` (#4809 merged with origin/main #4813). The reactions, picker, edited, deleted and attachment scenes are new, so they have no before. Every PNG was opened at 390 and 1440 in both themes. These are local captures on an isolated e2e Station, not native shells or physical devices. Times follow the capturing host's time zone.

[Design sketch](design-sketch.md) written before implementation.
